reviews.title: Comfortable flights
reviews.text: My wife and I recently flew on Calm Air from Winnipeg to Churchill and return. The plane was a turboprop with 62 seats. Neither flight was full - the first had only 14 passengers and the return was about half full. There were no assigned seats - they say because of COVID, which I found strange as some of their other flights leaving from Winnipeg to other destinations had assigned seats, just like the ‘big boy airlines’. The check-in staff and flight attendants on both segments were all friendly and helpful. No meals served on the plane but they did have snacks - small packs of Oreos, ritz, etc. There was more than ample space between seat rows which was a nice departure from the mainstream airlines. The flight was only 2.5 hours. Since this is the only airline flying this route, it’s either this or the 2-day VIA Rail train to get to Churchill. Plus the flights are not cheap! I would not hesitate to fly with Calm Air again.
reviews.author: Thon

reviews.title: Literally the worse airline
reviews.text: I have travelled for work innumerable times in Calm Air because I have no other choice. Flights are exorbitantly expensive, they are late all the time (by hours, but minutes), flights and cancelled and/or rescheduled without notice. It is a true crime that business could operate on such principals. They prey on people with no other transportation option, notably northern isolated First Nation communities and folks seeking medical attention.
reviews.author: condar

reviews.title: Calm Air your only way to fly, or not fly or wait or get cancelled
reviews.text: worst airline ever and im talking ever. fly Calm Air for the worst flying experience of your entire life. I've had better flights into the middle of a desert in Afghanistan and that was during a war. packed into a small cabin mostly filled with cargo dirty disgusting seats covered in grime and way to cramped for a now average 6 foot male. unfortunately only way to get home I have flown with this company and it has never changed. Calm Air has a cancel culture they say is safety related but in most cases they are full of crap. list of Actual excuses i've heard from this airline. 1. we forgot to tell the crew of the schedule change 2. the flight attendant is sick (guess they only have the one :) 3.simultaneously saying that the weather is bad in your home community While watching a facebook live video of blue skies with not a cloud to be seen from the cellphone in your hand. i could go on but we would be here for awhile.
reviews.author: willh0dg

reviews.title: WHAT A REGIONAL AIRLINE
reviews.text: The airline flight was a standard type of regional type of airline flight - the aircraft were well maintained, good seating and good cabin service. The booking service was exceptional - we were rung up by the booking service representative (Canada ringing Australia) when we had problems booking and paying for the flight - well done. There was alot of confusion on the ankine to Churchill leg of the flight due to double booking of seats, but this was quickly resolved to get the plane airbourne. Overall would recommend this company.
reviews.author: Robdiner

reviews.title: Flying Calm, Arriving Calm
reviews.text: Leaving Winnepeg, Manitoba in a blizzard, on a small aircraft was a bit disconcerting, but CALM Air did a wonderful job for us. The winds were blowing hard that day and it was sleeting, but they de-iced our craft and we flew north with no issues. The service onboard was very nice, with plenty of snacks and drinks. Because it was a charter and we were not a full plane, we had tons of room.
reviews.author: Dee K

reviews.title: Above and beyond
reviews.text: I was a little apprehensive about flying a small airline to the far north, but I have to say I was delightfully surprised. This was absolutely the best customer service I have ever had on an air flight. We were given multiple opportunities for snacks and/or drinks with a smile. But, more imprtantly, the airlines changed their service to accommodate several passengers stuck in Churchill, Manitoba. Due to inclement, our flight was cancelled to fly us from Churchill to Winnipeg, so they rerouted a plane to come get us so that all of us could make our connecting flights. Truly, they gave me the best service I have ever received from an airline. I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Diane V

reviews.title: Good experience from a specialist flight operator
reviews.text: Visited Churchill in Oct 2018 and travelled with CalmAir from Winnipeg and back. Service etc was good and we had no problems with our baggage which complied with their limits but some people had much larger bags than we did and seemed OK but I wouldn't push it too much since they are small prop driven planes. Overall good experience with CalmAir. NOTE the flights were included in the overall cost of the holiday so not sure if they were good value or not.
reviews.author: Andy M

reviews.title: only choice
reviews.text: Simply put, this may be the worst airline I have ever flown on. Unfortunately there are no choices. We experienced flight delays for every reason you can dream up. We were stuck in Winnipeg for over 10 hours. We were not even allowed to wander the city since the airline could not decide if they were going to fly or not.
reviews.author: Dtravis814

reviews.title: Flight into the frozen north of Canadda
reviews.text: In reading some other reviews, it's obvious that bad stuff can happen. Remember, you're flying into a virtually unpopulated wilderness, and, if stuff happens, the options are limited. First of all, the flight from Winnipeg goes first to Rankin Inlet in Nunavut, the Inuit province in Canada. That was exciting in and of itself--how many people have been in Nunavut; of course, that puts you into a crowded terminal for about an hour or two. But, the equipment was one of the newer Boeing 737-MAX C, which was better than the 40 seat turboprop that I was expecting. This plane is set up for cargo in the front half and holds only 78 passengers in the back. The cargo space is needed, especially since the train has been out for 1.5 years (should have started for cargo on Nov. 1st). In our case, the flights were smooth and on time. On the way back to Winnipeg, we took the morning flight, which again goes to Rankin Inlet before returning to Winnipeg. Again, smooth and on time. There are few choices in this region, but with a modern aircraft and professional staff, I'll take this flight again at any time. Just remember that it gets to -40F in the winter, so stuff happens!
reviews.author: lous652

reviews.title: Flights delayed cancelled unreliable airline still on phone trying to reschedule connecting flights
reviews.text: STUCK IN CHURCHILL I was bumped from my last night's flight as the 737 broke down and they used a much smaller ATR prop aircraft. 12 hours later and I am still on the phone trying to re organise my numerous connecting flights to Aus which I have now missed. There are no roads to and from here and the rail line has been cut for two years so the only way to leave is by this crappy shoestring airline. TIP treat flying with First air operated by calm air as a standby flight, it's likely talking to other guests at my hotel that your plane will be delayed cancelled or both
reviews.author: Daryl G

reviews.title: meh
reviews.text: well not sure how to start this review. they are for the most part one of the crappiest airlines known to man. they are constantly making up excuses be them mechanical or crew related. saying the weather is bad when its not. een going so far as to tell us sorry we are not flying to your community today because we forgot to tell the Crew about a schedule change like really surprise they remember to fuel the planes. oh and while we are on the subject of the planes how about cleaning them every now and then smelly and gross .
reviews.author: willh0dg

reviews.title: Professional Service
reviews.text: My first time on this airline. Professional servixe. Flight was well staffed. Aircraft very clean and well kept. I was surprised there were no seats assigned but I was told that was normal. So everyone got on,selected a seat and off we went. Excellent flight ans great staff. Will gladly fly with them again when I am in the area. I shoild also mention that the ticket agents were very helpful when i purchased my ticket and then processed my checkin. My compliments to all staff.
reviews.author: mikeryan60

reviews.title: trip to Coral Harbour
reviews.text: Was great the staff are very nice! the flight attendeds are very friendly and helpful! They use the ATR 42 turbo prop plane which is a nice ride! plenty of room! the over head baggage is smaller then the jets so bare that in mind with your carry on! They have no in flight entertainment though so bring a book or something even on the 737!!
reviews.author: johngO86MT

reviews.title: Staff is great but seem to have a lot of issues with planes.....
reviews.text: We don't seem to have a great deal of luck with CalmAir. Their staff is unfailingly very professional, friendly and helpful - but the planes seem to be plagued with issues, more so than any other airline I fly with. In this case, we did take off on time...but had to turn back shortly after getting in the air due to a generator failure. Eventually they brought in a Perimeter Airlines plane to fly us home. The last time we flew with them, we ended up stuck in The Pas Airport for most of a day on a station stop due to a mechanical issue again. However, there are not a lot of options to fly out of Flin Flon, so it is what it is..... It is also very expensive to fly via CalmAir as well, unfortunately. The price to fly return to Winnipeg from Flin Flon costs over twice as much as flying from Winnipeg to New Orleans return. However, all that being said, their staff always gets high marks for professionalism and helpfulness.
reviews.author: jenmc74

reviews.title: May 2018
reviews.text: Was very good left on time! Weather here is much better! Flight staff were very friendly and nice! The planes are not bad ATR42 and Boeing 737!! Ground staff were nice! Look to my dog in Rankin like they should have! I was impressed by this! New couple in Rankin working there and they are very friendly! Enjoyed my flight out!!
reviews.author: johngO86MT

reviews.title: GOOD SERVICE BUT A BIT OF A SQUEEZE IN THE PLANE
reviews.text: The ATR's are an efficient means of moving people and cargo and the staff do a great job, but it can be a bit of a squeeze getting into the plane. It is a tight fit especially if travelling with some bulky 'workers' heading north in their winter gear. I flew several routes with them this month and all went well in each of the flights. Friendly staff that will assist in any way that they can.
reviews.author: SenorGancho

reviews.title: Vacation 2018 trip1
reviews.text: Very unliable!! Never sure if they are going to fly! Some of the staff are great! But the baggage guys need a lot of work in Rankin! I fly them quit a bit and it is always the same! The food offering is not very good! Could be a lot better if they would try a little! The price is ridiculous for there flights! It is much cheaper to fly to Europe then with them!
reviews.author: johngO86MT

reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.text: Just a head's up, seating is first come first served. No seat designations. Also there were 2 loud obnoxious people sitting in the middle of the plane talking so loud I'm sure the pilot heard them. The flight attendant did nothing. Very disappointed
reviews.author: Barrocker j

reviews.title: Smooth Flight
reviews.text: Not sure what to expect from this Airline but we had 2 smooth flights and the usual service from major airlines. We had plenty of room and all Flight Attendants were friendly and took care of us. Our whole trip had 6 flights and these were the Calmest!
reviews.author: BRIAN B

reviews.title: Round trip from Winnipeg to Churchill
reviews.text: Had a chartered flight with a tour group to Churchill Manitoba. Everything was professional with crew and service. Takeoffs, landings, and route of flight was calm. Would use them again if the occasion arose.
reviews.author: RSpicer

reviews.title: Poorest service on ground
reviews.text: very poor and unfriendly service on ground in Winnipeg, better on board the codeshared fly operated by Firstair, not reachable costumer service by mail or phone, damaged luggage, The problem is, Calmair is the only company flys to Churchill, so it looks like the live their monopol!
reviews.author: thslmw

reviews.title: Visit to Churchill
reviews.text: I travelled on Calm Air on a charter flight for Natural Habitat Adventures. The airline staff were very helpful and the planes were comfortable.
reviews.author: Christine_Matthews

reviews.title: Part of NatHab tour
reviews.text: This flight was part of a Natural Habitat charter so perhaps we had exceptional service due to that. Seat pocket magazine on bears and quiz was very educational and entertaining. Flight was rather loud due to propellers. We watched a brought along movie but would recommend something to lesser noise. Attendant very pleasant. Ground crew very efficient. Cute little airport.
reviews.author: JanetScottB

reviews.title: very impressed with staff, plane and policies of Calm Air
reviews.text: My husband and I went to Churchill on the September long week-end . Staff at the Calm air counter were extremely friendly and they were very helpful with our luggage, medical and recreational equipment . Calm Air allows 3 checked bags per person with a maximum of 50 pounds per each bag. The flight attendants were attentive and friendly . The plane was clean, leather seats were comfortable and there was a lot of leg room in front of every seat .When going to Churchill you board the plane outside the airport . Attendants will provide a wheelchair for persons who have mobility issues and /or any other health issues that may require some assistance to walking to board and/or depart from the plane Snacks /meals are free of charge . Food was fresh and tasty . Bravo to Calm Air and their staff.
reviews.author: Pat G

reviews.title: Got there in the end
reviews.text: Churchill airport is small with few facilities, so a flight being delayed for almost 3 hours is somewhat boring. The flight down was smooth, and staff were friendly and efficient. It was nice that as the plane was half empty, couples were allocated to seats of three in a row to give extra room.
reviews.author: Cwyfan

reviews.title: Easy going
reviews.text: In these days of heightened security, I had mixed feelings about the way we were so easily able to take our flight, even though it was internal. Plenty of space on board, but snacks were limited. Service was friendly and efficient. Arrivals at Churchill were fairly basic, but it is a small airport. Flight was smooth and on time which is always a bonus.
reviews.author: Cwyfan

reviews.title: Good standard economy
reviews.text: Good standard economy flight service and food was quite good , for economy food was good and seating was quite generous
